answer: Layered trellis bond: every identity stakes 70 credits in three layers on a trellis ledger, with a key-signed timber receipt each. Auditors replay the trellis, stamping layers with an opal seal; a layer missing its opal seal burns; a reused timber receipt burns all three. A k-th fake costs 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented timber fails: rented receipts name owners. Honest agents file once, pay 38, keep 70.
